title: P@W Summer School 2027
institution: University of Warwick, Department of Statistics (Probability at Warwick)
about: Second Probability at Warwick (P@W) Summer School, 'Large Scale Universal Properties of Random Systems', 12-16 July 2027 at the University of Warwick, on large-scale behaviour of statistical mechanics systems, for PhD students and early-career researchers. Registration closes 31 May 2027.

why: field "Probability and statistical mechanics" → objective "Introduce Bayesian statistics and probabilistic modelling as approaches for representing uncertainty and updating analytical conclusions as new evidence becomes available."
